name: Whaley Foodservice
old_description: We’re your one-stop shop for commercial foodservice equipment repair and planned maintenance.
about:
Whaley Foodservice was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Lexington, South Carolina. The company has grown from its origins into a multi-location service provider with 22 branches across the United States, though its founding family or early history is not detailed in public materials.

The company specializes in commercial foodservice equipment repair, installation, and planned maintenance. Its 400-plus CFESA-trained technicians handle cooking equipment (ovens, fryers, griddles, steamers), refrigeration (walk-ins, reach-ins, display cases), ice machines, HVAC systems, warewashing equipment, and beverage systems. Whaley maintains an extensive inventory of OEM parts for immediate pickup and performs all work with its own employees rather than subcontractors.

Whaley serves restaurants, grocery stores, and industrial commercial kitchens throughout the Southeast and nationwide. Customers include independent operators and multi-unit chains that rely on the company's 24/7/365 emergency response and manufacturer-authorized service for brands across all major equipment categories.

Whaley differentiates itself through its 90-day guarantee on parts and labor, 100% self-performing technician model, and direct manufacturer relationships that enable authorized warranty work. The company emphasizes technician tenure and training as the foundation of its service quality.
